title: RNA3D-Decoy: A Large-Scale Benchmark Dataset of AI-Generated RNA Structure Models for Quality Assessment
authors: Chen X; Yadi H; Cao R; Liu H
one_liner_zh: 该文构建了AI生成RNA结构模型的基准数据集，用于质量评估，虽对象为RNA而非蛋白质，但其结构质量评估框架可迁移至蛋白质体系，对蛋白质结构计算有借鉴意义。
abstract: Recent advances in AI- RNA structure prediction have increased the availability of candidate models, but their accuracy remains variable. Developing reliable quality assessment (QA) methods requires datasets that represent contemporary prediction errors across diverse targets and molecular contexts. Here, we present RNA3D-Decoy, a large-scale benchmark dataset comprising 103,549 decoys for 677 experimentally determined targets, including 416 RNA-only structures,117 RNA structures with metal ions, and 144 RNA-protein complexes. Decoys were generated using five biomolecular predictors: AlphaFold 3, ESMFold2, Protenix, Chai-1, and Boltz-2.Each decoy is evaluated against its experimental reference us-ing TM-score, lDDT, and RMSD, with global and local quality annotations where applicable. DockQ scores additionally characterize RNA-protein interface quality. Target grouping incorporates both RNA and protein sequence relationships to support dataset partitioning. Analyses reveal distinct quality distributions across dataset levels and target-dependent differences among predictors, with each predictor contributing the highest-TM-score model for a subset of targets. Broad pooled score distributions also coexist with limited within-target score variation, particularly for RNA-protein complexes, emphasizing the importance of target-level characterization. By combining AI-generated decoys, standardized quality labels, and structured metadata, RNA3D-Decoy provides a resource for developing and evaluating methods for global quality estimation, local error prediction, and candidate-model ranking. The data set and accompanying code are available at: https://github.com/HamiltonChenLab/RNA3D-Decoy.
abstract_zh: 近年来，AI在RNA结构预测方面的进展增加了候选模型的可用性，但其准确性仍然参差不齐。开发可靠的质量评估（QA）方法需要能够代表跨不同靶标和分子环境中当代预测误差的数据集。在此，我们介绍了RNA3D-Decoy，这是一个大规模基准数据集，包含677个实验确定靶标的103,549个诱饵，其中包括416个仅RNA结构、117个含金属离子的RNA结构，以及144个RNA-蛋白质复合物。诱饵是使用五种生物分子预测器生成的：AlphaFold 3、ESMFold2、Protenix、Chai-1和Boltz-2。每个诱饵均使用TM-score、lDDT和RMSD与其实验参考进行评估，并在适用情况下提供全局和局部质量注释。DockQ分数额外表征了RNA-蛋白质界面质量。靶标分组结合了RNA和蛋白质序列关系以支持数据集划分。分析揭示了跨数据集级别的不同质量分布以及预测器之间依赖靶标的差异，每个预测器为一部分靶标贡献了最高TM-score模型。广泛的合并分数分布也与有限的靶标内分数变化共存，特别是对于RNA-蛋白质复合物，强调了靶标级别表征的重要性。通过结合AI生成的诱饵、标准化质量标签和结构化元数据，RNA3D-Decoy为开发和评估全局质量估计、局部误差预测和候选模型排名方法提供了资源。数据集及附带代码可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/HamiltonChenLab/RNA3D-Decoy。
